ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass centered at the peduncle junction, branching into dense mottling along the inner lobe margins; dominant high-intensity white fields on the lateral lobes containing scattered dark punctate spots; distinct diagonal dark band on the distal right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 48 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; notable deep indentations on the left lobe margin and extreme jagged irregularity at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep on both lobes, significantly modified by marginal tissue irregularities and jagged trailing edge erosion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast circular pixel clusters (light on dark) within the central pigmentation zone; dark circular spots scattered across the white peripheral areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the medial right lobe and lower sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge degradation with prominent jagged excision at the right distal tip and significant serration-induced tissue loss on the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique diagonal pigmentation slash on the upper right fluke tip and asymmetrical dark mottling pattern bordering the median notch.
